ai_summary: Aurum PropTech Limited confirms no deviation in the *use* of its Rs. 343.56 crore Rights Issue proceeds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, having utilized Rs. 303.89 crore as per its stated objectives and approved re-allocations. A key concern, however, is the Rs. 1.45 crore of net proceeds still pending from shareholder calls, which contributes to the Rs. 28.56 crore total unutilized funds and indicates an ongoing issue with fund collection.
